newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Independent climbs above 85 pct of W&H.
newsitem.headline: Independent climbs above 85 pct of W&H.

text.p: Independent Newspapers Plc (INP) has raised its stake in New Zealand publisher Wilson and Horton to at least 85 percent through the takeover offer which ended on Friday, a spokesman for the company said.

INP's bidding vehicle Independent Press Communications Ltd (IPCL) was offering NZ$11/share or 1.375 exchangeable INP shares for each Wilson and Horton share. INP and family trusts linked to principal Tony O'Reilly held 45.15 percent of Wilson and Horton prior to the bid.
"We're just a shade over 85 (percent)," the spokesman said, adding a definitive figure would be announced on Monday. He said INP was very happy with the outcome.
